text:
anna: Quick FYI — we're updating the parental leave coverage process for teammates taking leave in Q2. Please add coverage plan here: https://tiny.redwood.link/leave-cover-rotas by Fri EOD. Mention backup childcare needs if you want stipend.

people-ops-bot: Reminder — submit Parental Leave Request form: https://intranet.redwood/pforms/parental within 30 days of expected leave start.

elaine: Thanks — two quick q's: 1) If I do a 4-week phased return at 60% do I need to update payroll? 2) Can we schedule overlap week for handoff?

michelle (People Ops): 1) Yes — payroll needs the phased-return form (link above). We'll coordinate with payroll to set pro-rated pay. 2) Overlap week is recommended and covered as regular hours. Fill 'handoff' slot on the rota.

james: Volunteering to cover on-call for Elaine weeks 2 & 3. Added to the sheet.

sam: Added a mini handoff checklist — copying here so folks can reuse:
```
- Current projects & owners
- Pending PRs/tasks with links
- Key creds/access + who holds them
- Any scheduled customer calls in the leave window
- Emergency contact & escalation path
```

elaine: awesome, thanks. Also re: backup childcare stipend — how does that work for parents with newborns who need short-term backup care?

michelle (People Ops): Stipend: up to $600/month for up to 3 months, can be used for backup care or nannies. Submit receipts to benefits@redwood.com. For international locations we'll do local equivalent — ping me if you need details.

anna: Note for managers: please confirm coverage plan (1-line) in the rota and @-mention your coverage lead so HR can approve.

michelle (People Ops): Filing deadline reminder: parental leave paperwork must be in 30 days prior for expected leave >= 6 weeks; for shorter leaves, within 7 days of start. Exceptions: adoption/surrogacy — contact me.

people-ops-bot: New HR checklist uploaded: https://intranet.redwood/leave-checklist.pdf :thumbsup:

james: Quick operational question — can we set 2 volunteers per week so we have redundancy?

anna: yes, prefer 2. Also, if both are out, fallback is the delivery on-call pool (team leads will rotate).

elaine: thanks all. I'll fill the rota and copy the checklist to my doc.

michelle (People Ops): Happy to review your draft handoff if you want — DM me when you post it.

sam: tagging @people-ops for a short AMA session Thursday 11am? Might help sync managers.

michelle (People Ops): Yes — scheduling a 30m drop-in Thursday 11-11:30, invite out now.

anna: great. Thanks everyone :heart:
